It means something bigger!"}},{"id":"step-04","stepType":"learn","title":"Learn It","studentText":"In a two-digit number, each digit has a place:

**23** means:
• 2 in the TENS place = 2 groups of ten = 20
• 3 in the ONES place = 3 single ones = 3
• Together: 20 + 3 = 23

**57** means:
• 5 tens = 50
• 7 ones = 7
• 50 + 7 = 57

**Key idea:** The position of a digit tells you its value!","owlText":"","interaction":{"type":"none"},"media":{"illustration":{"approvedUrl":"data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20400%20200%22%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%22400%22%20height%3D%22200%22%20fill%3D%22%23f8fafc%22%20rx%3D%2212%22%2F%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%22200%22%20y%3D%2228%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20font-size%3D%2214%22%20font-weight%3D%22bold%22%20fill%3D%22%23334155%22%3ELets%20Learn%20Math!%3C%2Ftext%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%22200%22%20y%3D%2290%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20font-size%3D%2240%22%20fill%3D%22%236366f1%22%3E%F0%9F%94%A2%20%E2%9E%95%20%E2%9E%96%20%E2%9C%96%EF%B8%8F%20%E2%9E%97%3C%2Ftext%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%22200%22%20y%3D%22130%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20font-size%3D%2215%22%20font-weight%3D%22bold%22%20fill%3D%22%234f46e5%22%3EMathematics%20is%20all%20around%20us!%3C%2Ftext%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%22200%22%20y%3D%22155%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20font-size%3D%2211%22%20fill%3D%22%2364748b%22%3ECount%2C%20add%2C%20subtract%2C%20measure%20and%20explore!%3C%2Ftext%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%22200%22%20y%3D%22180%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20font-size%3D%2210%22%20fill%3D%22%2394a3b8%22%3EGrade%202%20Mathematics%3C%2Ftext%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E","approvedByAdmin":true}}},{"id":"step-05","stepType":"connect","title":"Real Life Connection","studentText":"When you count groups of ten — like 10 crayons in a box — the tens place tells you how many groups of ten you have!","owlText":"When do you see this in your daily life?
